Title: Generally Available: Azure Load Testing Now Supports Locust

Body.Content:
Azure Load Testing now supports Locust, a Python-based open-source framework for performance testing. You can use your existing Locust scripts with Azure Load Testing to easily generate high-scale load and identify performance bottlenecks. Locust is a developer friendly framework that lets you write code to create load test scripts as opposed to using GUI based test creation. 

Learn more.
